description.short_caption: Crusted scabies with hyperkeratotic plaques in the axilla and upper torso.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the axilla and adjacent upper torso of a patient with extensive hyperkeratotic, crusted plaques. The lesions are thickened, scaly, and appear to involve the skin diffusely, consistent with crusted scabies. The surrounding skin shows erythema and scaling, suggesting widespread involvement. The image is well-lit and provides a clear view of the affected area.
visible_findings: diffuse involvement of axilla and upper torso
